    Multi-Method Optimization Wrapper for Macroeconomic State-Space Models

    ssm_optimizer_wrapper_core.Rd

    Executes sequential numerical optimization across specified algorithms (e.g., Nelder-Mead, BFGS) via optimx::optimx to estimate structural parameters for macroeconomic state-space models. Supports warm starts, chaining optimization steps across multiple iterative macro loops, and mapping between unconstrained optimizer space and economic parameter bounds.

    ssm_optimizer_wrapper_core(
  ssm,
  methods = NULL,
  iters = NULL,
  start_par = NULL,
  set_silent = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    ssm

    A list defining the standardized structural model specification, containing name, parameter metadata (manifest), observation/exogenous data (data), and system matrix builders (builders).

    methods

    Character vector of optimization algorithms supported by optimx (e.g., c("Nelder-Mead", "BFGS")).

    iters

    Integer. Number of sequential optimization loops to execute.

    start_par

    Optional numeric vector of initial unconstrained parameters (\(\theta\)) for warm starts. If NULL, values are initialized from ssm$manifest.

    set_silent

    Logical. If TRUE (default), suppresses verbose parameter transformation logs.

    Value

    A named list containing:

    params

    Named list of final estimated parameters transformed into structural economic space.

    theta

    Named numeric vector of final estimated parameters in unconstrained optimizer space.

    fit_summary

    The optimx convergence and estimation summary table from the final pass.

    ssm

    The structural state-space model blueprint list.

    See also

    loglik_ssm_core, param2model_gen, model2param_gen
